name: Client Playsound
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Anthony4933Meow
description: a simple playsound mod to play sounds client-side from resourcepacks

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Client commands that play any sound only for you: /ps <sound> (alias /cps), /ss stops it, /setvol and /setpitch change it, /rs replays it; each shows a green check in the action bar.
note: Not yet: The sound itself can't be checked by the script; its settings (triggers) screen doesn't open under Kiln.
